verdict.root_cause: Platform-automation rewrote shippingservice's QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR to http://quoteservice-gone:8090 about two minutes before onset, with no matching revert unlike the three prior applications that day [tr_be915e3e37f1]. From the 19:50:45 change point checkoutservice's error ratio rose ~34x [tr_b57a1efb2e83], and failing traces localise the first ERROR to checkoutservice's client call to ShippingService/GetQuote, with shipping's work truncating at its outbound HTTP client hop instead of reaching the quote call [tr_f1ed1bc7307c]. shippingservice logs inbound GetQuote requests that never produce the quote-sent completion line seen earlier [tr_0c78921f0445], and checkout logs PlaceOrder entries with no payment, email or queue-write follow-up [tr_89b911dc756c]. Neither checkoutservice nor quoteservice has any recorded change [tr_e02cf4febc25, tr_be1a0f4b5fdf]. The mechanism is a configuration value that itself names a non-existent destination, so the quote call never completes and checkout aborts before payment.
verdict.reasoning: Traces put the first error on the shipping quote hop with cart, catalog and currency children clean and no payment span at all [tr_f1ed1bc7307c]; shipping's logs show the handler entered but never completing, with no error text - consistent with an outbound call to an unresolvable host [tr_0c78921f0445]; checkout's logs show the same truncation from the caller side [tr_89b911dc756c]. The only change near the 19:50:45 onset is the QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR edit [tr_be915e3e37f1, tr_b57a1efb2e83]. It is bad_config rather than dependency_latency because the address value is itself wrong, and not bad_deploy because the nearest image change was ~12.2h earlier and was a revert [tr_be915e3e37f1]. checkoutservice alerted first but only inherits a failed downstream call.
open_questions: quoteservice was never probed directly for health; its innocence is inferred from an empty change log [tr_be1a0f4b5fdf], not a positive signal.
Why checkout errors are bursty with a ~0.28 peak rather than near-total [tr_b57a1efb2e83] - possibly partial replica rollout or retries; no per-replica breakdown available.

shippingservice span-metrics are absent in both windows [tr_a3ea319834fe], so shipping-side error rate and GetQuote latency are unmeasured, and whether a restart is needed for a reverted value to take effect is unknown.

alternatives.root_cause: quoteservice degraded on its own and shippingservice's handler hangs waiting on it.
alternatives.why_not: quoteservice has no recorded change [tr_be1a0f4b5fdf] while shipping's quote address was repointed minutes before onset [tr_be915e3e37f1]; shipping truncates at the outbound client hop rather than inside a real quote call [tr_f1ed1bc7307c].

alternatives.root_cause: shippingservice handler/connection capacity is consumed by calls blocked on an unreachable host, failing requests on exhaustion.
alternatives.why_not: No saturation evidence was gathered (shipping metrics empty [tr_a3ea319834fe]) and no crash or restart lines appear [tr_0c78921f0445]; this would be a downstream effect of the wrong address, which remains the mechanism.

proposal.expected_effect: Removing QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR=http://quoteservice-gone:8090 and recreating shippingservice should restore its outbound quote hop: shipping logs resume a quote-sent line ~10ms after each inbound GetQuoteRequest and ship-order/tracking-id lines reappear; checkout logs resume payment, email and queue-write lines after each PlaceOrder; checkoutservice 2m error ratio falls from ~0.048 mean toward the ~0.0014 baseline; new traces reach PaymentService/Charge instead of erroring at the GetQuote client span.
proposal.if_wrong: Falsified if after 10 minutes shipping still logs inbound GetQuote with no quote-sent line, or checkout error ratio stays near 0.048, or traces still error at the GetQuote client span. That would point at quoteservice being genuinely unhealthy — never probed directly — or at the prior config being no better.
proposal.risk: Recreating the container drops in-flight GetQuote/ShipOrder calls, briefly worsening checkout failures. If the recorded prior value is not the healthy one, shipping returns with no usable quote address. The platform-automation loop that set this value four times in a day may rewrite it within minutes unless stopped.
proposal.blast_radius: shippingservice restarts; checkoutservice sees resets during recreate, propagating to frontend and loadgenerator orders; quoteservice sees quote traffic return to it.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Checkout alerted first and its downstream consumers (accounting, email, fraud detection, quote) followed three minutes later, with the load generator affected last — a real multi-service failure fanning out from checkout. No open incident covers it and nothing in the alerts pins a cause yet.
